cohort: 633 lactating mothers of infants under the age of 6 months living in Mekelle city, Tigray, Northern Ethiopia
finding: Maternal education, parity, caesarean section delivery, and breastfeeding information and support were significant determinants of early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was found to be a significant determinant of early initiation of breastfeeding, with mothers who delivered via caesarean section being less likely to initiate breastfeeding early.
